survival.title: Survival
description: Lose a life for each round lost

bestOfSeries.title: Best of Series
description: Player with most points after 5 rounds wins

rules.title: Rules
description: Rock Paper Scissors is simple: choose rock, paper, or scissors. Rock beats scissors, paper beats rock, and scissors beat paper.
In each round, predict your opponent's choice and respond accordingly!

group.title: Group
description: Play with up to 4 players! Only one can win each round. If you're out early, the remaining players continue until a winner is determined.
In survival mode, each player has a set number of lives. Be the last player standing to win!

bots.title: Bots
description: Play against bots! They follow a random strategy, so if you can figure it out, you can beat them consistently!

info.waitForRoundEnd: Please wait for the round to conclude.
